comment: Legacy (unsalted) site references. 'ascii': printable-ASCII labels, whose reference Python computes exactly as the database does (tests/test_salted_site_ref_migration.py checks every one against the database's own expression). 'needs_database': labels whose reference depends on the database's lower-casing and trimming (a final sigma, a dotted capital I, U+1E9E, the C0 separators, U+0085, the Unicode spaces): the CLI must REFUSE to guess them and ask for --legacy-ref.
